title: Mandy's Trip to Space
subtitle: 考点：科幻故事 / come true / outer space
passage: Mandy loves science fiction. Her favourite book is about a girl who travels to another planet. Last night, Mandy had a strange dream. In the dream, she was a pilot, and she flew a small spaceship into outer space.

Through the window, Mandy saw the Earth. It looked small and blue, like a ball. Then she met a friendly robot named Zip. Zip said, “Welcome! Shall we visit the Moon first?” They landed on the Moon, and Mandy jumped very high because it was so light there. She also found a tiny garden with colourful flowers.

Suddenly, an alarm rang, and Mandy woke up. It was only a dream! She laughed and wrote down everything in her notebook. Perhaps she will write her own sci-fi story one day. Her father told her, “Many things in old sci-fi books have come true. Maybe your dream will, too.” Mandy smiled and went back to sleep.
